name: wow-pull-playlist
description: Desktop app that starts a playlist when a World of Warcraft combat pull begins.

scripts.dist:win: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test dist/main/pullDetector.test.js dist/main/combatLogTailer.test.js dist/main/playlistProviders/youtubeProvider.test.js dist/main/playlistProviders/localMediaProvider.test.js dist/main/playlistProviders/index.test.js dist/main/localMediaResolver.test.js dist/main/combatLogDiscovery/windowsCombatLogDiscovery.test.js dist/main/playerLifecycle.test.js dist/main/playlistRules.test.js dist/main/youtubeSessionPrivacy.test.js
